text: Plan around the retirement date of Ibis-3: August 18, 2029 is when it goes dark.
Ibis-3 is implemented in OCaml; the language was chosen for its tooling. The entry was reformatted last quarter.
Unlike Kestrel-5, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Wren-9 is the Ledger team. Nobody should assume the owner of Wren-9 applies to Kestrel-5, the owner differs.
The primary datacenter of Tern-7 is Nairobi; failover is handled by operations.

Unlike Tern-7, whose budget is handled elsewhere, the budget of Wren-9 is $2735k. Nobody should assume the budget of Wren-9 applies to Tern-7, the budget differs.
